description: This file defines a serializer class for the BitVector32 type, implementing methods to serialize and deserialize BitVector32 instances for the Orleans serialization framework.

classes.name: BitVector32Codec
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IFieldCodec for serializing and deserializing BitVector32 objects within Orleans serialization.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a BitVector32 value into the writer stream, writing a field header and the integer data.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a BitVector32 value from the reader stream, reading an integer and constructing a BitVector32 object.
